Package com.sandy.sconsole.ai.config

Record Class FallbackInfo

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.sandy.sconsole.ai.config.FallbackInfo
Record Components:
guards - models per failure kind
defaults - models for the kinds that have no list of their own
public record FallbackInfo(Map<FailureKind,List<String>> guards, List<String> defaults) extends Record
Where a job goes after a model fails it for good: an ordered list of models per failure kind, and a default list for the kinds without one. A later model in a list takes the job only while every earlier one is unavailable.
